name: Towering Bugbear

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: Some bugbears are just built bigger. You've learned how to use your imposing size to loom over your enemies menacingly. You are Large instead of Medium (as usual for Large ancestries, this does not increase your reach). Enemies within your reach take a –1 circumstance penalty to saves against your fear effects.
